import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('data.lammps', 'dump.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd_analyzer = msd.EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz')
msd_analyzer.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd_analyzer.times
msd_data = msd_analyzer.results.timeseries

# Skip first 500ps (500,000 steps = 500 frames at 1000 step intervals)
start_idx = 500
msd_data = msd_data[start_idx:]
time = time[start_idx:]

# Find melting point by detecting sudden jump in MSD
# Calculate rolling average of derivative
window = 5
dmsd = np.gradient(msd_data)
rolling_dmsd = np.convolve(dmsd, np.ones(window)/window, mode='valid')
threshold = np.mean(rolling_dmsd) + 2*np.std(rolling_dmsd)
melting_idx = np.where(rolling_dmsd > threshold)[0][0] + start_idx

# Calculate diffusion coefficient in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) in the long-time limit
molten_msd = msd_data[melting_idx-start_idx:]
molten_time = time[melting_idx-start_idx:]
D = np.mean(molten_msd/(6*molten_time))

# Convert from Å²/ps to m²/s
D_si = D * 1e-4

print(f"{D_si:.6e}")

import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('data.lammps', 'dump.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD for all atoms
msd_analyzer = msd.EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz')
msd_analyzer.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd_analyzer.times
msd_data = msd_analyzer.results.timeseries

# Skip first 500 ps (500,000 steps)
skip_frames = 500
msd_data = msd_data[skip_frames:]

# Find melting point (sudden jump in MSD)
diff = np.diff(msd_data)
melting_frame = np.where(diff > np.mean(diff) + 2*np.std(diff))[0][0] + skip_frames

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) for 3D diffusion
# Convert to m²/s (LAMMPS metal units: Å²/ps -> m²/s)
msd_slope = np.polyfit(time[melting_frame:], msd_data[melting_frame-skip_frames:], 1)[0]
D = msd_slope / 6.0  # Å²/ps
D_si = D * 1e-4  # Convert to m²/s

print(f"{D_si:.6e}")

import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('Al.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
ag = u.atoms
msd_analyzer = msd.EinsteinMSD(ag, msd_type='xyz', fft=true)
msd_analyzer.run()

# Get MSD data
msd_data = msd_analyzer.results.timeseries
times = msd_analyzer.results.times

# Skip first 50ps (50,000 timesteps)
skip_frames = 50  # Since we dump every 100 steps, 50ps = 50 frames
msd_data = msd_data[skip_frames:]
times = times[skip_frames:]

# Find melting point as sudden jump in MSD
msd_diff = np.diff(msd_data)
melting_idx = np.where(msd_diff > np.mean(msd_diff) + 2*np.std(msd_diff))[0][0]
melting_time = times[melting_idx]

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) in 3D
molten_msd = msd_data[melting_idx:]
molten_times = times[melting_idx:] - times[melting_idx]
# Fit line to get diffusion constant
fit = np.polyfit(molten_times, molten_msd, 1)
D = fit[0]/6  # in Å²/ps

# Convert to m²/s
D_si = D * 1e-4  # Convert Å²/ps to m²/s

print(f"{D_si:.6e}")

from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('Al.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
ag = u.atoms

msd_analysis.run()

# Get MSD data

time_data = msd_analysis.results.times

melting_idx = start_idx + np.argmax(msd_gradient)

molten_time = time_ps[melting_idx:]

# Convert D to m²/s (from Å²/ps)
D_SI = D * 1e-4

print(f"{D_SI:.10e}")

molten_msd = msd_values[melting_idx:]
molten_time = time[melting_idx:]
D = np.polyfit(molten_time, molten_msd, 1)[0] / 6.0  # Å²/ps

# Convert to m²/s (1 Å²/ps = 1e-8 m²/s)
D_si = D * 1e-8

print(f"{D_si:.6e}")
